title: Stochastic interpolants with data-dependent couplings
tldr_zh: 把 base 写成目标的退化观测 x0=m(x1)+σζ，同一平方回归学速度场；ImageNet 补全 FID 1.13 vs 独立耦合 1.35，64→256 超分 FID 2.05
tldr_en: Base samples are degraded observations of the target, x0=m(x1)+sigma*zeta; same square-loss training; ImageNet inpainting FID 1.13 vs 1.35 independent, 64->256 SR FID 2.05.
key_numbers: ImageNet inpainting FID-50k: dependent coupling 1.13 vs uncoupled interpolant baseline 1.35 (Table 2)
ImageNet 64->256 super-resolution FID train/valid: 2.13/2.05 vs I2SB -/2.70, Cascaded Diffusion 4.88/4.63, SR3 11.30/5.20 (Table 3)
